column1: # The sign 2 with a superscript in doc. 192: form seen at each of its 67 places (21 Nov 2026).
# reading = the consonant the reading takes there (b = one of the 14 places of 192-repairs.tsv, c = the key's value).
# Round 1: two Claude instances, each shown only the sign cut out of the image (x8), no reading, no key, no neighbours.
#   Criterion written and hashed before the survey (sha256 c4488fdc...): from the top of the sign only,
#   R = curved head as in a printed 2, Z = flat bar meeting the diagonal at a corner, D = doubtful.
# Round 2: two further instances, each shown the boxed sign with the signs beside it for scale, no reading, no key.
#   Criterion written after round 1 had been joined to the readings (sha256 7aeec299...), so not a first look:
#   S = squat 2, lower than its neighbours, small hooked head, long base; T = tall z; D = doubtful.
#   Bar set before round 2: rename a token only if both readers give S, and only if both give S at no more than 3 of
#   the 53 places read c. Both gave S at 4, so no token is renamed.
# The boxes were placed by two other instances that had the transcription and were told not to judge shape.
# context = the output of decode.py (declared repairs applied) for three signs either side, the sign itself in <>.
